pages.title: Overview
pages.user_question: What is this framework and what are its headline findings?
pages.methodological_warning: All figures are modeled network accessibility, not observed travel behavior.

pages.title: Urban Typology
pages.user_question: What kind of urban environments exist across Istanbul?
pages.methodological_warning: Typology is descriptive, not causal, and never entered any routing/accessibility computation.

pages.title: 15-Minute Istanbul
pages.user_question: What everyday needs can residents potentially reach by walking?
pages.methodological_warning: NaN nearest-time means unreachable within the 15-minute search horizon, not 'very far'. Do not call this 'living in a 15-minute city'.

pages.title: Cycling Gain
pages.user_question: Where does cycling materially expand accessibility compared with walking?
pages.methodological_warning: Modeled potential at a constant 15km/h baseline speed; not validated mode-choice or observed behavior.

pages.title: Transit Connection
pages.user_question: Where can cycling expand access to public transport?
pages.methodological_warning: NO_FEED_COVERAGE != NO_TRANSIT_SERVICE. Use QUALITY-AWARE figures for any citywide claim.

pages.title: Accessibility Gaps
pages.user_question: Where do mapped accessibility gaps remain, and how many people are associated with them?
pages.methodological_warning: Use neutral 'accessibility gap' language only -- never 'service desert', 'mobility poverty', or 'underserved community'.

pages.title: E-bike
pages.user_question: Where is e-bike deployment potential highest, and does it align with measured accessibility gains?
pages.methodological_warning: Cross-application convergence is descriptive co-location, NOT validation of either application.

pages.title: Data & Methods
pages.user_question: How was this built, what are its sources, and where should results not be over-interpreted?
pages.methodological_warning: This page hosts the full methodology_registry and claims_registry -- the authoritative source for all interpretation limits.

design_principle: Question-driven, not feature-driven. The user never needs to know which internal 'Phase' produced a page's data.
